lunch.name: Mapo Tofu (Spicy Tofu in Sauce)
lunch.description: Sichuan classic - soft tofu in spicy sauce with ground pork. Name means pockmarked old woman who invented it
ingredients: 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
instructions: Cut tofu into cubes, set aside
Heat oil, add garlic and ginger, cook 1 minute
Add pork, break up and cook until no pink
Add soy sauce, sugar, white pepper, Sichuan peppercorns and broth
Bring to simmer, add tofu gently
lunch.notes: Handle tofu gently to avoid breaking. Sichuan peppercorns create numbing sensation
lunch.fun_fact: Mapo Tofu is Sichuan classic, name means pockmarked old woman who invented it. One of Eight Great Traditions of Chinese cuisine
